newsitem.title: GREECE: Ecu/drachma biased down, forwards slip before FOMC.
newsitem.headline: Ecu/drachma biased down, forwards slip before FOMC.

text.p: Greek depos were steady but implied drachma rates from forex forwards were softer by a tenth of point in short tenors before the FOMC meeting, ecu/drachma was biased downwards and bonds were little changed, traders said.
"Depos are holding but implied drachma rates from forex forwards have eased about 10 basis points in short tenors as the market expects the FOMC to up $ rates," said a dealer at a private bank.
Bonds were stable in the secondary market after Monday's mini-rally in fixed coupon bonds, dealers said.
"It is quiet today after yesterday's pick up in fixed coupon bonds," said a senior dealer at a private bank.
The mark was quoted at 159.27/32 from Monday's 159.495 fix, the dollar at 269.77/87 drachmas from 270.870 and the ecu at 311.01/11 from 311.100 drachmas.
"Ecu/drachma is biased downward trading just above 311," said a senior dealer at a private bank. "I think the market will test lower ecu/drachma levels soon."
The dealer said the sharp rise of the yen against the drachma coupled with the drachma's weakness formed a dangerous mix that should be dealt with.
The pool of outstanding corporate loans denominated in yens is big and the Japanese currency's rise makes it more expensive for Greek companies to serve, the dealer said.
